question: Among healthcare providers whose practice location is in Mountain View, CA, and who have a specified specialization in the field healthcare provider taxonomy, identify the top 10 most common specializations based on the count of distinct NPIs. Then determine which of those top 10 has a count of distinct NPIs closest to the average count across those 10 specializations.

  SELECT 
    npi,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_1,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_2,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_3,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_4,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_5,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_6,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_7,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_8,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_9,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_10,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_11,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_12,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_13,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_14,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_15
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nppes.npi_optimized` 
  WHERE provider_business_practice_location_address_city_name = 'MOUNTAIN VIEW' 
  AND provider_business_practice_location_address_state_name = 'CA'
),
all_taxonomy_codes AS (
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_1 AS taxonomy_code FROM mountain_view_npis WHERE healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_1 IS NOT NULL AND healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_1 != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_2 FROM mountain_view_npis WHERE healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_2 IS NOT NULL AND healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_2 != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_3 FROM mountain_view_npis WHERE healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_3 IS NOT NULL AND healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_3 != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_4 FROM mountain_view_npis WHERE healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_4 IS NOT NULL AND healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_4 != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_5 FROM mountain_view_npis WHERE healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_5 IS NOT NULL AND healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_5 != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_6 FROM mountain_view_npis WHERE healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_6 IS NOT NULL AND healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_6 != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_7 FROM mountain_view_npis WHERE healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_7 IS NOT NULL AND healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_7 != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_8 FROM mountain_view_npis WHERE healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_8 IS NOT NULL AND healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_8 != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_9 FROM mountain_view_npis WHERE healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_9 IS NOT NULL AND healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_9 != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_10 FROM mountain_view_npis WHERE healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_10 IS NOT NULL AND healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_10 != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_11 FROM mountain_view_npis WHERE healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_11 IS NOT NULL AND healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_11 != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_12 FROM mountain_view_npis WHERE healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_12 IS NOT NULL AND healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_12 != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_13 FROM mountain_view_npis WHERE healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_13 IS NOT NULL AND healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_13 != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_14 FROM mountain_view_npis WHERE healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_14 IS NOT NULL AND healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_14 != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_15 FROM mountain_view_npis WHERE healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_15 IS NOT NULL AND healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_15 != ''
),
spec_counts AS (
  SELECT b.specialization, COUNT(DISTINCT a.npi) AS distinct_npi_count
  FROM all_taxonomy_codes a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nppes.healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_set` b ON a.taxonomy_code = b.code
  WHERE b.specialization IS NOT NULL AND b.specialization != ''
  GROUP BY b.specialization
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT specialization, distinct_npi_count
  FROM spec_counts
  ORDER BY distinct_npi_count DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT 
  specialization,
  distinct_npi_count,
  AVG(distinct_npi_count) OVER () AS avg_count,
  ABS(distinct_npi_count - AVG(distinct_npi_count) OVER ()) AS abs_diff
FROM top10
ORDER BY abs_diff ASC
LIMIT 1
